producer.calling_convention: Microsoft x64: RCX owner CCharacter*, RDX active council task*, R8B GUI eligibility=1, R9 native vector object*; no consumed return value

temporary_vector_allocator.release_behavior: inline data is a no-op; grown data is delegated through allocator vtable+0x38 to the fallback allocator vtable+0x10

active_steward_task_resolution.selection_rule: exactly one generation-valid active task for the played owner and required position; zero, duplicate, malformed or owner-mismatched matches remain unavailable

transaction.admission: application-main and paused before the producer
transaction.binding: upstream snapshot/date/revisions/played owner plus same-frame generation-valid active steward task
transaction.lifetime: binding state owns the 0x210 allocator and 0x18 vector object from one producer entry through one release callback
transaction.release_pairing: every admitted producer callback, including a producer failure after vector initialization, leaves one terminal release callback for the Council6 core
transaction.after_frame: active task is independently resolved again after release; Council6 compares pointer, full identity and frame fields before publication
transaction.failure_policy: fail closed with no candidate rows

unknown_or_excluded: candidate skill, politics and native AI score
semantic fire, reassign or swap actions
unique_next_integration_entry: a separate glue work package may register these private sources and adapt the existing application-main campaign snapshot callback; it must not change this exact native object contract

enrichment_access_adapter.precondition: attached steward binding with released private vector and a bound steward frame
enrichment_access_adapter.callbacks: existing CaptureFrameThunk and IsMainThreadThunk plus exact binding read_memory and resolve_character operations
enrichment_access_adapter.restriction: callbacks fail outside application-main, without frame binding, or while the private vector transaction is active
